levels.description_zh: 先在三路各放一株莲卫，再用芽源供给能量。
levels.description_en: Start with a Lotus on each lane, then grow your energy with a Sprout.

levels.description_zh: 疾风移动更快。藤障争取时间，莲卫负责清除。
levels.description_en: Gusts move quickly. Vines buy time for your Lotus guards.

levels.description_zh: 重砾更耐打。莲卫空闲时蓄能，升级可增强回应。
levels.description_en: Stones endure. Lotus guards store charge while idle; upgrades strengthen their response.

levels.description_zh: 枢纽会照料邻路受损的守卫。让防线不只依赖攻击。
levels.description_en: A Nexus supports damaged guards on neighbouring lanes. Defence needs more than attacks.

levels.description_zh: 密集扰动会触发枢纽减速。先建设，再选择开波时机。
levels.description_en: Dense disturbances trigger a Nexus slowdown. Build before you launch the next wave.

levels.description_zh: 综合运用供能、蓄能、阻挡与照料。每一波之间都能重新布阵。
levels.description_en: Combine supply, stored charge, barriers and support. Reorganise between waves.
